def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter, deque
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    cells = {(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] != bg}
    comps=[]
    unseen=set(cells)
    while unseen:
        seed=unseen.pop(); comp={seed}; q=[seed]
        while q:
            r,c=q.pop()
            for p in ((r-1,c),(r+1,c),(r,c-1),(r,c+1)):
                if p in unseen:
                    unseen.remove(p); comp.add(p); q.append(p)
        comps.append(comp)
    template=max(comps,key=len)
    r0=min(r for r,c in template); r1=max(r for r,c in template)
    c0=min(c for r,c in template); c1=max(c for r,c in template)
    ar=(r0+r1+1)//2; ac=(c0+c1+1)//2
    shape=[(r-ar,c-ac,grid[r][c]) for r,c in template]
    markers=[p for comp in comps if comp is not template for p in comp]
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for r,c in markers:
        out[r][c]=bg
        for dr,dc,v in shape:
            rr,cc=r+dr,c+dc
            if 0<=rr<h and 0<=cc<w: out[rr][cc]=v
    return out

program='''def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    background = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    remaining = {(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] != background}
    components = []
    while remaining:
        seed = remaining.pop()
        component = {seed}
        stack = [seed]
        while stack:
            r, c = stack.pop()
            for neighbor in ((r - 1, c), (r + 1, c), (r, c - 1), (r, c + 1)):
                if neighbor in remaining:
                    remaining.remove(neighbor)
                    component.add(neighbor)
                    stack.append(neighbor)
        components.append(component)

    template = max(components, key=len)
    rmin = min(r for r, c in template)
    rmax = max(r for r, c in template)
    cmin = min(c for r, c in template)
    cmax = max(c for r, c in template)
    anchor_r = (rmin + rmax + 1) // 2
    anchor_c = (cmin + cmax + 1) // 2
    shape = [(r - anchor_r, c - anchor_c, grid[r][c]) for r, c in template]
    markers = [cell for component in components if component is not template for cell in component]

    result = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r, c in markers:
        result[r][c] = background
        for dr, dc, color in shape:
            nr, nc = r + dr, c + dc
            if 0 <= nr < h and 0 <= nc < w:
                result[nr][nc] = color
    return result
'''
